caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular textile or patterned piece, predominantly composed of a detailed red and white design. The background is a solid off-white color, and the patterned object in the center is filled with intricate motifs including floral forms, stylized stars, and symmetrical arrangements. The text appears to repeat and vary around the border, and some words such as "WASHINGTON" are recognizable.
